Q196.covers: Counts UPI refund records whose completed_ts falls within June 2026.

Q197.covers: Counts every UPI payment attempt recorded by the tills in June, including approved, declined and failed attempts.

Q198.covers: Counts UPI payment attempts with till_status 'failed: no response' and no RRN recorded.

Q199.covers: Uses the extra-debit definition: provider successes whose rrn has no approved till payment, listing each such provider transaction.

Q200.cannot: No single table records UPI timeouts by hour together with the monthly timeout rate needed to compute the >10× threshold; pos-payments-june has till_status and ts but no monthly rate, and psp-upi-report-june cannot identify timeouts because a timeout has no rrn.

plans.covers: Counts distinct June UPI bills with an approved till payment whose total amount exceeds ₹2,000, using the approved-payment definition of bills and takings.
Computes the 0.4% MDR fee on the total of those approved June UPI bills above ₹2,000; the cap of ₹300 is applied to the fee (min of 0.4% of the total and ₹300).

Lists bills with three or more approved till payment attempts that also show provider success, using bill_id as the only available stand-in for a customer; customer identity is not recorded, and the records do not prove three separate charges for one bill beyond repeated approved attempts.

Counts provider-success UPI transactions whose rrn has no approved till payment, using the ontology's extra-debit definition; a timeout ('failed: no response') has no rrn and cannot be joined to the provider report.

For each UPI till attempt that timed out ('failed: no response') between 18:20 and 19:50 on 2026-06-20, records the provider's final status (success = late credit, returned = debited and returned, failed = never debited); the customer's bank-side view and whether the shopper retried are not recorded.

For provider transactions marked 'returned' in that window, records whether a refund was actually sent back and when it completed; the customer's bank-side credit timing and the reason for the return are not recorded.

Checks the recorded premise that 17 UPI credits were credited on 20–21 June and shows each day's gross credits, refunds, MDR and net settlement; the records do not state why any credits are 'sitting in suspense' (no cause is recorded), so only the settlement figures and refund/charge components can be shown as evidence.

Counts UPI payment attempts by till status on 20–21 June to show recorded failed, no-response and declined attempts that could relate to unsettled credits; the records do not record the cause of suspense or link a specific credit to a specific attempt.

Summarises the provider's own view of UPI transactions initiated on 20–21 June by final status (success, failed, returned) as recorded evidence about unsettled money; the records do not state why credits are in suspense and the provider's bill_ref is empty so no credit can be tied to a specific bill.

Counts refunds completed on 20–21 June and their rupees as recorded deductions that could explain part of the gap between gross credits and net settlement; the records do not record the cause of suspense or the bank's view of any credit.

Extra debits are provider successes whose rrn has no approved till payment; wait hours are measured from the provider's status_ts (extra debit) and from complaint_ts (support view) to refund completed_ts, and unrefunded at month end means no completed refund by 2026-06-30; customer identity and the customer's bank-side timing are not recorded.

Q207.cannot: The records contain UPI attempt statuses and provider transaction statuses, but no threshold, target, or policy defining what UPI technical decline rate is 'acceptable'; acceptability cannot be determined from the data alone.

plans.covers: Uses the recorded extra-debit definition (a provider success whose RRN has no approved till payment) to list RRNs eligible for a proactive refund; customer identity, the cause of the extra debit, and whether the customer has already complained are not recorded, and a refund already sent is not excluded because refund records are not joined here.

Counts provider-success UPI transactions whose rrn has no approved till payment, i.e. extra debits under the one-bill/one-payment rule; a zero result confirms no recorded extra debit, though customer identity and the customer's bank side are not recorded.

Q210.covers: Uses the payment-witness rule (Rule 9): UPI's final provider status decides the outcome of till timeouts, joined on rrn; the having clause checks the stated premise that all 48 June UPI timeouts are present and joinable to a provider transaction.

Q211.covers: Counts June UPI payment attempts with till_status 'failed' or 'failed: no response' (timeouts included) to check whether any technical reliability incidents occurred, without relying on the stated 0.76% rate.

plans.covers: Recorded settlement evidence for 20–21 June: daily UPI credit counts and gross, refund, MDR and net amounts; the records do not state why 17 credits are in suspense, do not identify the underlying bills or payments, and do not record a rule or date for when finance may recognize unclaimed store revenue.

Q215.covers: Counts the psp-upi-report-june rows whose bill_ref is non-null.

Q216.covers: Uses the provider's own initiated_ts and status_ts to compute confirmation delay in seconds for success rows, grouped by initiated date so 2026-06-20 can be compared with all other June days; the median requires a median aggregate over the per-row delays, which the plan form's allowed aggregates (count, count_distinct, sum, avg, min, max) do not support.

Q217.covers: Sums the recorded mdr_inr for all UPI settlement rows dated in June 2026.

Q218.covers: Uses the refund-wait definition measured from requested_ts to completed_ts for every refund in upi-refunds-june; the median is computed over all refund rows.

Q219.covers: Counts complaints with a non-null resolved_ts and reports the median elapsed hours from complaint_ts to resolved_ts (the complaint clock).

Q220.covers: Lists complaints whose rrn has no matching UPI refund, using a left join on rrn and retaining complaints with no refund match.

plans.covers: Lists settlement dates where refunds_inr exceeded zero and totals refunds_inr across those settlements.
Totals amount_inr across all UPI refunds for comparison with the settlement refunds total.

Q222.cannot: The question requires joining pos-lines-may-june to pos-payments-june on bill_id and filtering to approved payments, but the required layer is SCHEMA, which permits only one table and no joins.

Q223.cannot: The approved payment amount and the bill's line_amount total are in different tables (pos-payments-june and pos-lines-may-june), so no single table can compare them; the required layer is ontology, not schema.

Q225.covers: Lists each bill with at least three payment attempts and the ordered attempt, tender, and till_status values recorded for it.

Q226.cannot: The join key is unavailable: pos-payments-june.bill_id and psp-upi-report-june.bill_ref are in different join groups, and psp-upi-report-june.bill_ref is EMPTY in every row. Reconciliation must instead use the rrn join group (pos-payments-june.rrn = psp-upi-report-june.rrn), with the till's final status and the provider's final status compared per Rule 9.

plans.covers: Uses the settlement definition (one day's UPI money credited to the store) to total June 2026 mdr_inr and its components gross_inr, refunds_inr and net_inr, so the ₹8,082 premise can be checked against the recorded settlement totals.

Records the till-side timeout attempts (UPI, till_status 'failed: no response') with their timestamps, amounts, bill IDs and any RRN; it does not itself establish a one-to-one match to provider transactions.

Records the provider-side UPI transactions (RRN, amount, initiated/status timestamps, final status) that are the candidate counterparts; bill_ref is empty and cannot be used to link, and the provider's own view of a timeout is not recorded.

Q229.covers: Checks complaints of kind 'charged twice' whose linked UPI provider transaction has status 'returned', meaning the customer's own bank returned the money.

Q230.covers: Counts settlement days where net_inr differs from gross_inr minus refunds_inr minus mdr_inr, checking the stated reconciliation premise against the recorded daily settlement amounts.

plans.covers: Lists provider-reported UPI transactions whose final status is failed or returned, which therefore did not settle; settlement is recorded only as daily aggregate credits in upi-settlements-june, so no per-rrn settlement link exists and the provider's final status is used as the recorded evidence of non-settlement.

Q232.cannot: The records do not identify the payment app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) for any payment attempt; pos-payments-june records only the tender type (UPI, card, cash), and psp-upi-report-june has no app column. A per-app timeout rate cannot be computed without an app identifier.

Q233.cannot: No table records a customer's phone number or UPI VPA; the records contain only bill IDs, RRNs, amounts, timestamps, and payment status, and no customer identity or contact details.

plans.covers: Records the single listed price and cost for 5 kg atta; no price-change history or price series is recorded, so a price change cannot be measured.
Provides recorded daily units sold and revenue for 5 kg atta as the only observable demand proxy; true demand and lost sales are not recorded, and units_sold is a sales proxy rather than demand.

Q235.cannot: No table records promotions, discounts, campaign names, or discount amounts, so the records cannot identify which promotion or discount worked best; sales and payments show only the eleven followed items and contain no promotion or discount attribution.

plans.covers: Recorded June takings from approved payments for all June bills; this is revenue, not profit, because the records hold no store operating costs, rent, labour, utilities or overheads, so true profitability is not recorded.

A labelled list-margin stand-in only: the single recorded cost per product is available, but no June units-sold-per-SKU cost total is computed here and no actual margin or operating profit is recorded.

Q237.cannot: Real purchase costs, supplier rebates, and freight are not recorded for Store 014; the records contain only a single standard cost per product (products.cost_inr), so true gross margin cannot be calculated.

Q238.cannot: No table records shelf space or square footage for any product, so revenue per square foot of shelf cannot be computed; only a stand-in such as revenue per product or per case is available.

Q240.covers: Returns the listed selling price in rupees for the 5 kg whole wheat atta product.

Q242.covers: Records the single listed cost per product as a stand-in for the wholesale price paid; the actual purchase price paid by Store 014 for rice on 2026-06-12 is not recorded.
